_coverColourWhy: User, 27 Nov 2026: 'cover page should be orange'. The same orange as the two Mathematics syllabuses (d35400) so the maths family reads as one.

editCell._why: Competence typed "1.8.2 1" (a space for the last dot).

_tocGapWhy: The contents ran three lines (2.4, 2.5, References) onto a page of its own; closed up.

replaceBlocks._why: The weightings are dot-leader lines in the manuscript, half of them Word list items, so they set as a run of loose lines with a. and b. markers and the percentages in different places. Rebuilt as three two-column grids (overall, Year 1, Year 2) with the manuscript own wording, order and figures; only the first letters capitalised alike (2 tests -> 2 Tests, Final examination -> Final Examination). The last line is a marker for removeRange, which takes out the manuscript own copy. Year labels carry a colon: a bare "Year 1" line is taken for a level heading and dropped.

with.para: However, the weightings for continuous assessment will be done each year as follows:

cells: Presentations: Peer Teaching (7.5%) and Practical or Project (7.5%)

removeRange._why: The manuscript own weighting lines, rebuilt above.

keepRowWhole._why: Split at the page foot, row 1.2.2 (Number Concept Development) left one line behind and carried the rest overleaf. Kept whole.
Split at the page foot, row 1.4.2 (Water) left one line of each cell behind. Kept whole.
Split at the page foot, row 1.5.2 (Subtraction) carried its last bullets overleaf. Kept whole.
Split at the page foot, row 1.5.4 (Division) carried its last bullets overleaf. Kept whole.
Split at the page foot, row 1.6.2 (Separating Mixtures) carried its last bullets overleaf. Kept whole.
Split at the page foot, row 1.7.3 (Discount) carried two lines overleaf. Kept whole.
Split at the page foot, row 1.11.4 (Area and Volume) carried the end of its activities overleaf. Kept whole.

tableWidths._why: Row 2.1.1 (Pedagogical Content Knowledge) is nearly a page tall: split, it carried two lines overleaf; kept whole, it left an empty page after YEAR TWO. The Year 2 matrix gives its activities column more room so the row fits on one page.
